Born in Assam, raised in Dimapur, Nagaland

I was born in Assam and grew up in Dimapur, Nagaland. It's a part of India that rarely makes it onto anyone's slide deck, which is probably part of why I like building things and telling stories that don't usually get told.

Professionally, I've spent six years in B2B sales. It started at MyCaptain, where four promotions took me from cold calling as a BDE to leading a floor of 20+ people. Then Hourglass Research, running market intelligence and enterprise business development for Fortune 500 and GCC clients. Most recently MathCo, working Fortune 500 accounts like Mars, Coca-Cola, and Adidas across North America, EMEA, and APAC, and helping build $3M+ in pipeline along the way.

What actually interests me is the work behind the numbers. Figuring out who the real decision makers are, what a company needs before I pitch them anything, and mentoring the people I work with. Outside of sales, I'm building TripMate and Grand Prix Archive, both because I enjoy making something exist that didn't before.

That's the throughline, really: whether it's an enterprise deal, a startup, or a race dashboard nobody asked for, I like being part of something while it's still being built.
